verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Zoho Books supports generating financial reports generally (custom reports with date-range/filter controls, MCP-enabled 'pull reports just by asking', accountant access to 'generating reports') but never explicitly names or documents P&L, balance sheet, or cash-flow statement generation specifically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/screenshots of P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement generation for arbitrary periods, and any independent/hands-on verification of their accuracy.
